components.name: pH and EC Sensors

components.name: Reservoir Heaters or Coolers

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Commercial hydroponic system for indoor or greenhouse agriculture using nutrient film technique (NFT) or deep water culture (DWC) with integrated water circulation and controlled environment modules.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: The most common hydroponic systems adopted worldwide for commercial and hobbyist use focus on NFT and DWC due to their efficiency in water and nutrient use and scalability. These systems consist of modular components with distinct supply chains designed to support plant growth in controlled environments.

components.name: Nutrient Film Technique (NFT) Channels
components.reasoning: These channels form the core growing beds where plants are situated and nutrient solution flows; they are modular and procured as separate molded plastic or polymer extrusions.

components.name: Reservoir Tank
components.reasoning: The reservoir holds the nutrient solution; it is a separately manufactured tank integral to the system's recirculating design and procured distinct from the channels or pumps.

components.name: Circulation Pump
components.reasoning: This pump circulates nutrient solution through channels and back to the reservoir; it is a key mechanical component with its own supply chain and standardized procurement.

components.name: Frame or Structural Support Assembly
components.reasoning: The framework supports the channels and reservoir; often modular metal or plastic extrusion assemblies procured separately and essential for system stability and space utilization.

components.name: Control Unit (Pump Controller and Timers)
components.reasoning: This electronic unit manages pump operation cycles for solution flow timing; typically a packaged controller with a separate supply chain and distinct functional role.

components.name: Air Pump and Air Stones
components.reasoning: Used to oxygenate the nutrient solution especially in reservoir tanks; these are distinct components often procured separately but may be omitted in simpler systems.

components.name: Drainage and Return Manifolds
components.reasoning: These are assemblies used to collect and return nutrient solution from the channels back to the reservoir; often modular pieces procured apart from the main channels and pumps.

components.name: Lighting Fixtures (LED grow lights)
components.reasoning: While not structural, artificial lighting is critical in controlled-environment hydroponics; LEDs are a distinct purchased assembly but may vary or be omitted in daylight-dependent systems.

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Commercial hydroponic system with recirculating nutrient film technique (NFT) using modular channels and integrated reservoir tanks.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: The recirculating nutrient film technique (NFT) with modular channels represents the industry standard for scalable hydroponic agriculture in commercial applications due to its efficient nutrient use and modularity, enabling mass production and customization.
